meta.name: docx
meta.description: Use this skill whenever the user wants to create, read, edit, or manipulate Word documents (.docx files) or Word templates (.dotx files). Triggers include: any mention of 'Word doc', 'word document', '.docx', '.dotx', or requests to produce professional documents with formatting like tables of contents, headings, page numbers, or letterheads. Also use when extracting or reorganizing content from .docx or .dotx files, inserting or replacing images in documents, performing find-and-replace in Word files, working with tracked changes or comments, or converting content into a polished Word document. If the user asks for a 'report', 'memo', 'letter', 'template', or similar deliverable as a Word or .docx file, use this skill. Do NOT use for PDFs, spreadsheets, Google Docs, or general coding tasks unrelated to document generation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 创建并编辑带格式的Word文档
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果经常需要制作或修改格式复杂的Word文档。
copy.tagline_en: Create and edit formatted Word documents.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you frequently produce or modify Word documents with complex formatting.

howto.what: 它会按你的要求新建、读取或修改 Word 文档(.docx/.dotx):加入目录、页码等格式,也能替换图片、查找替换、处理修订和批注,完成后转成图片检查排版。
howto.when: 当你提到“Word 文档”“.docx”等关键词,或要求把报告、备忘录等做成 Word 文件,或要提取、调整文档内容、插图、修订等时触发。

say.text: 把这份会议纪要生成带目录和页码的 Word 文档。
say.note: 会新建 .docx 并渲染检查排版。

say.text: 读取 report.docx,把标题改成黑体并加一条批注。
say.note: 先读内容再修改,批注会锚定到文字。

say.text: 在 contract.docx 里把“甲方”替换成“委托方”,保留修订标记。
say.note: 以修订形式写入,便于审阅。

howto.what_en: Claude creates, reads, edits, and manipulates Word documents (.docx/.dotx). It adds TOCs, page numbers, letterheads, images, find-and-replace, tracked changes, and comments, then renders the result to images to check the layout.
howto.when_en: Triggers on mentions of Word docs or .docx/.dotx, or requests for a report/memo/letter/template as a Word file; also for extracting content, editing images, find-and-replace, tracked changes, or comments.

say_en.text: Make a Word doc from these notes, with a TOC and page numbers.
say_en.note: Creates a .docx and renders it to check the layout.

say_en.text: Open report.docx, bold paragraph 2, and add a comment.
say_en.note: Reads the file, edits it, and anchors the comment to text.

say_en.text: In contract.docx, replace “Party A” with “Client” as a tracked change.
say_en.note: Edits are recorded as revisions for review.
